title.narrative: Reduction of number of fatalities and serious injuries in the Republic of Serbia

description.narrative: Reduction of number of fatalities and serious injuries in the Republic of Serbia Fatalities statistics

comment.narrative: Deaths reduced in Serbia by 7.9 during 2020 and much less in 2021 while road injuries have reduced by 10.9 in 2020 compared to 2019. This may be the result of COVID19 restrictions which also affected public transport and traffic in the country. It will not be possible to get an accurate assessment of impact in terms of actual numbers of deaths and injuries until the data systems and local road safety activities are fully operational in local communities and National traffic levels return to normal levels.
